title: Version 2.1.101 - Team Onboarding & Performance Improvements
description: Added /team-onboarding command for generating teammate ramp-up guides, OS CA certificate trust by default, interactive Google Vertex AI setup wizard, and numerous performance improvements including faster diff computation and reduced memory usage.

title: Version 2.1.98 - Enhanced Security & Permissions
description: Fixed command injection vulnerability in POSIX which fallback, added Monitor tool for streaming events, subprocess sandboxing with PID namespace isolation, and improved permission checks.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code limits are starting to feel like a psychological trick
Claude Code Found a Linux Vulnerability Hidden for 23 Years

title: Version 0.37.1 - Latest Stable Release
description: Dynamic sandbox expansion and worktree support for Linux and Windows, broad nightly update featuring UI polish, core fixes, and new tools.

title: Main Branch - Claude 4.5/4.6 and GPT-5.3/5.4 Support
description: Added support for Claude 4.5/4.6 models and updated model aliases, expanded Gemini model support with 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite, added Gemini 3 preview models, added DeepSeek Reasoner model, and added support for GPT-5.3/5.4 model variants across OpenAI, Azure, and OpenRouter.

title: Bugbot Learned Rules and MCP Support
description: Bugbot can now learn from feedback on pull requests and turn those signals into learned rules, added MCP support for additional context during code reviews, and introduced new Cursor 3 interface with Agents Window.

title: Version 0.37.0 - Dynamic Sandbox Expansion
description: Implemented dynamic sandbox expansion and worktree support for Linux and Windows, added chat resume footer on session, and broad nightly update with UI polish.

title: Copilot CLI BYOK and Local Models Support
description: Copilot CLI now supports Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) and local model configurations for enhanced flexibility.

title: Model Availability Update (April 7, 2026)
description: Updating model availability for ChatGPT sign-in users - removing gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-mini, gpt-5.1-codex-max, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1, and gpt-5 from model picker.

title: Copilot SDK in Public Preview
description: Copilot SDK now available in public preview, enabling developers to build custom integrations and extensions.

title: Cursor 3.0 Launch - New Interface
description: Major interface overhaul with multi-repo layout, seamless agent handoff, agent switching options, faster and cleaner performance. Includes Design Mode for browser UI element annotation.

community_feedback.quote: With this launch of Cursor 3, I'll probably get off Cursor for good...
The main reason we pay for cursor is for bugbot, that alone pays for...

title: Copilot Cloud Agent Research, Plan, and Code
description: Research, plan, and code with Copilot cloud agent - new agentic capabilities for comprehensive development workflows.

title: Version 0.118.0 - Enhanced Networking & Device Code Login
description: Added Windows sandbox OS-level networking enforcement, ChatGPT device code login flow, support for prompt-plus-stdin workflow in codex exec, and dynamic bearer token fetching for custom model providers.
